issues.issue: Did the amalgamation of the credit unions qualify under s. 87 of the Income Tax Act, requiring flow-through of tax attributes?
issues.applicant_position: Envision argues flow-through applies only if all predecessor property becomes amalgamated corporation's property; some properties sold at amalgamation so flow-through not met.
issues.respondent_position: Respondent argues s. 23(b) CUIA causes all predecessor property to be amalgamated corporation's property, satisfying s. 87 ITA conditions.
issues.result_text: Amalgamation was qualifying; s. 87 ITA conditions fulfilled by s. 23(b) CUIA; appeal dismissed.

issues.issue: Could the credit unions contract out of s. 23(b) of the CUIA to exclude surplus properties from amalgamation?
issues.applicant_position: Envision argues s. 20 CUIA allows contracting around s. 23(b) effect for particular properties, so surplus properties passed to subsidiary, not Envision.
issues.respondent_position: Respondent argues s. 23(b) is mandatory and not subject to contracting out; s. 20 cannot override s. 23 effects.
issues.result_text: Section 23(b) is mandatory; parties cannot contract out to exclude property from amalgamation.

issues.issue: Were the sale and amalgamation agreements effective despite the amalgamation and s. 23(b) CUIA?
issues.applicant_position: Envision suggests sale agreements meant surplus properties passed to subsidiary, not Envision, so s. 23(b) effect avoided.
issues.respondent_position: Respondent argues predecessors lost separate legal personality at amalgamation; Envision was vendor and successor obligated to fulfill agreements.
issues.result_text: Sale agreements were effective; Envision was seized of surplus properties and fulfilled obligations.

issues.issue: Does the Income Tax Act create a look-through or tracing rule allowing tracing of predecessor property to shares of subsidiary to avoid s. 87 flow-through?
issues.applicant_position: Envision argues ownership of shares of subsidiary does not mean ownership of subsidiary's property; s. 87 flow-through does not apply.
issues.respondent_position: Minister argues broad property definition and s. 87 language create look-through or tracing rule.
issues.result_text: Court rejects tracing rule; ITA language not explicit enough to create such rule.
